analysis.analysis: This is a classic volatility regime transition with deeply negative GEX creating a fragile market structure where small flows can cause outsized moves. The LightGBM models have all flipped bullish during this transition, but this is occurring against a backdrop of elevated VIX (22.22) and extreme negative gamma exposure. The CAG spike to 1.74 suggests positioning has become delusionally bullish despite the unstable underlying structure. This creates a dangerous setup where bullish sentiment meets a market structure prone to violent downside moves.
analysis.regime_assessment: Volatility regime transition with unstable gamma structure - high probability of sharp directional moves
analysis.model_trust: Low trust - models may be giving false signals during regime transition as they struggle with the unstable volatility environment and conflicting signals
analysis.risk: Severe downside gap risk due to negative gamma amplification - any negative catalyst could trigger cascading sell pressure with limited dealer support
analysis.action_detail: Implement protective puts or VIX calls immediately - the negative GEX environment makes current bullish positioning extremely vulnerable to sudden reversals
